import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from your_module import Symptom, ConsultationRequest

class TestSymptoms(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.symptom = Symptom("Headache")
        self.consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()

    def test_add_new_symptom(self):
        # Arrange
        new_symptom = Symptom("Fever")
        # Act
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(new_symptom)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request.symptoms), 2)

    def test_view_symptom_details(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)
        # Act
        details = self.consultation_request.get_symptom_details(self.symptom)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(details, {"id": 1, "description": "Headache"})

    def test_update_symptom_details(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)
        # Act
        self.consultation_request.update_symptom_details(self.symptom, {"description": "Migraine"})
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(self.consultation_request.get_symptom_details(self.symptom), {"id": 1, "description": "Migraine"})

    def test_delete_symptom_details(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)
        # Act
        self.consultation_request.delete_symptom_details(self.symptom)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request.symptoms), 0)

    def test_delete_symptom_details_with_consultation_request(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)
        self.consultation_request.add_consultation_request()
        # Act
        self.consultation_request.delete_symptom_details(self.symptom)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request.symptoms), 1)

    def test_delete_symptom_details_with_multiple_consultation_requests(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)
        self.consultation_request.add_consultation_request()
        self.consultation_request.add_consultation_request()
        # Act
        self.consultation_request.delete_symptom_details(self.symptom)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request.symptoms), 1)

    def test_delete_symptom_details_with_no_consultation_requests(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)
        # Act
        self.consultation_request.delete_symptom_details(self.symptom)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request.symptoms), 0)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
